summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 17, 2026, reporting April and May 2026 production results from its grid-connected wave energy station at Jaffa Port, Israel. The release details electricity generation and peak power output under varying wave conditions, noting a peak of 39.1 kW in May and approximately 54 kW in February. The filing incorporates certain paragraphs into the company's existing Form F-3 registration statements. This is routine operational reporting, not a special situation. No transaction, corporate action, or event covered by the special-situations categories is present; the filing is an ordinary current report.
